subject.title: docs(install): add vendor-neutral NVIDIA Jetson install guide

question: After the NVIDIA setup guidance is corrected, should OpenClaw first-party docs include a vendor-neutral NVIDIA Jetson install guide?
rationale: The linked issue asks maintainers to confirm the boundary between first-party vendor-neutral hardware docs and ClawHub/vendor-owned turnkey hardware promotion; automation can fix stale setup facts but cannot choose that docs scope.

options.title: Accept vendor-neutral Jetson docs after repair
options.body: Land the focused guide once the NVIDIA setup guidance is current and the page avoids commercial hardware references.

options.title: Route Jetson docs outside core
options.body: Close or pause this PR and ask contributors to keep Jetson-specific guidance in vendor or ecosystem docs instead.

recommendation.title: Accept vendor-neutral Jetson docs after repair
recommendation.body: Land the focused guide once the NVIDIA setup guidance is current and the page avoids commercial hardware references.

likelyOwner.reason: VISION.md and recent docs rewrite history make this the strongest available owner signal for the first-party docs scope decision.
